subject: [RFC PATCH v2 03/18] fuse: don't move a folio with PG_rcu_free into a fuse file

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch prevents a folio marked for RCU freeing from being moved into a fuse file, which can lead to issues when the folio is still being copied by a lockless page cache read. This happens in specific scenarios where a mapped file page is gifted and then truncated. The patch instead copies such a folio as fuse would do if it cannot take one. This change ensures that fuse files handle folios marked for RCU freeing correctly.
